2026-08-05.title: Cabinet Approves Samudra Manthan Scheme
bullets: Bullet 1: Kya hai Samudra Manthan scheme, jiska uddeshya offshore oil aur gas exploration ko badhava dena hai, aur ismein Petroleum Ministry ka mahatvapoorn yogdan hai.
Bullet 2: Is scheme ke liye 84,084 crore rupees ka budget outlay kiya gaya hai, jiska uddeshya 5 saal mein offshore oil aur gas exploration ko badhava dena hai.
Bullet 3: Yeh scheme Bharat ke urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, kyunki yeh desh ki oil aur gas ki maang ko poora karne mein madad karega aur desh ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava dega.

2026-08-05.title: Cabinet Approves Khelo India Scheme
bullets: Bullet 1: Kya hai Khelo India scheme, jiska uddeshya desh mein khel ko badhava dena hai, aur ismein Youth Affairs aur Sports Ministry ka mahatvapoorn yogdan hai.
Bullet 2: Is scheme ke liye 36,441 crore rupees ka budget outlay kiya gaya hai, jiska uddeshya desh ke khiladiyon ko international level par prashikshit karna hai.
Bullet 3: Yeh scheme Bharat ke yuvaon ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, kyunki yeh unhein khel mein career banana mein madad karega aur desh ki khel vyavastha ko bhi sudharaega.

2026-08-05.title: Cabinet Approves Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana
bullets: Bullet 1: Kya hai Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana, jiska uddeshya desh mein floating solar power ko badhava dena hai, aur ismein New aur Renewable Energy Ministry ka mahatvapoorn yogdan hai.
Bullet 2: Is scheme ke liye 5,070 crore rupees ka budget outlay kiya gaya hai, jiska uddeshya 5,000 MW floating solar capacity ko viksit karna hai.
Bullet 3: Yeh scheme Bharat ke urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, kyunki yeh desh ki urja ki maang ko poora karne mein madad karega aur desh ki paryavaran vyavastha ko bhi sudharaega.

2026-08-05.title: Cabinet Approves Coastal Highway Project
bullets: Bullet 1: Kya hai coastal highway project, jiska uddeshya Odisha mein Rameshwar aur Paradeep ke beech ek coastal highway ka nirmaan karna hai, aur ismein Road Transport aur Highways Ministry ka mahatvapoorn yogdan hai.
Bullet 2: Is project ke liye 8,300 crore rupees ka budget outlay kiya gaya hai, jiska uddeshya 100 km ki doori ko cover karna hai.
Bullet 3: Yeh project Bharat ke infrastructure ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, kyunki yeh desh ke samudra tatt ke saath judne mein madad karega aur desh ki arthvyavastha ko bhi badhava dega.

2026-08-05.title: Cabinet Approves SARTHAK-PDS Scheme
bullets: Bullet 1: Kya hai SARTHAK-PDS scheme, jiska uddeshya desh mein public distribution system ko modernize karna hai, aur ismein Consumer Affairs Ministry ka mahatvapoorn yogdan hai.
Bullet 2: Is scheme ke liye 25,530 crore rupees ka budget outlay kiya gaya hai, jiska uddeshya desh ke 100% population ko cover karna hai.

Bullet 3: Yeh scheme Bharat ke ann suraksha ke liye mahatvapoorn hai, kyunki yeh desh ke logon ko sasti aur acchi gunvatta wale ann uplabdh karane mein madad karega aur desh ki arthvyavastha ko bhi sudharaega.
